Privacy notice

Last updated: 23 October 2026

For children and families: You can choose and download a drawing without giving us your name or creating an account. There are no ads, chat rooms or upload buttons. The company hosting the website receives technical information to deliver and protect it. Ask an adult before sending an email; do not send children’s names, photos or school details.

1. Controller and contact

The operator below is responsible for personal information they receive and decide how to use. GitHub also processes technical data for its own hosting and security purposes as described in its statement.

2. Data and purposes

SituationInformationPurpose
Opening a page or print viewIP address and technical request information processed by the hosting serviceDeliver content, operate the service and maintain security
Emailing the operatorEmail address, name if supplied, message and attachmentsAnswer the enquiry, investigate a reported problem or handle a rights request
Legal obligations or disputesRelevant correspondence and limited supporting recordsMeet applicable obligations and establish, exercise or defend legal claims

The studio does not add visitor analytics, advertising pixels, fingerprinting, mailing-list software or profiling. It does not buy personal information or use download details for advertising. There is no automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effects. Supplying an email is voluntary and is not required to download a drawing. Without contact information, an enquiry may not be answerable.

3. Legal bases

For correspondence handled by the operator, the basis under EU GDPR Article 6(1)(f), and UK GDPR where applicable, is the legitimate interest in answering requests, keeping the service secure and resolving issues, subject to the individual’s rights and reasonable expectations. Records necessary to meet a specific legal obligation rely on Article 6(1)(c). Handling legal claims may rely on legitimate interests and applicable legal requirements. Visiting a page is not consent to marketing. GitHub’s own legal bases for its processing are set out in its privacy statement.

4. Recipients and service providers

Hosting: GitHub Pages serves the website and handles technical requests and security logs. See the GitHub General Privacy Statement.

Email: The contact mailbox is provided by Atomic Mail, operated by AtomicMail Systems OÜ, Harju tn 3 // Vana-Posti tn 2, Tallinn 10146, Estonia. Atomic Mail processes messages and associated delivery and security information to provide the mailbox. See its privacy policy.

Only the operator reads and answers incoming correspondence on behalf of this project. The operator does not forward messages, keep copies outside Atomic Mail, or use AI tools to read, analyse or answer them. Incoming correspondence is not published, sold or used for marketing. Information may be disclosed where required by law or necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

5. International processing

The operator manages the project from Spain. GitHub processes information internationally, including in the United States. Its privacy statement describes applicable adequacy arrangements and contractual safeguards.

Atomic Mail is operated by an Estonian company. Its policy describes its own mail infrastructure separately from its AI services and states that, where international transfers occur, it relies on adequacy decisions or standard contractual clauses with additional safeguards where needed. The operator uses Atomic Mail for correspondence and does not submit that correspondence to Atomic GPT or other AI services. A company address does not establish the location of every server or email recipient; this notice does not promise that all email processing stays within Spain or the EEA.

Contact the operator for information about transfers relevant to your correspondence and how to obtain information about applicable safeguards. The providers’ linked policies give further details about their own processing.

6. Retention

The operator deletes ordinary enquiries and their attachments from the mailbox, including sent copies and trash, no later than six months after the enquiry is resolved, and sooner when no longer needed. No separate copies are kept outside Atomic Mail.

Relevant records may be retained longer where necessary for a legal obligation or to establish, exercise or defend a legal claim. In those cases, retention is limited to the necessary records and the applicable legal or claim period; the ordinary six-month period does not override those requirements.

Provider-operated technical logs and backups follow the providers’ own retention policies. Deletion from the mailbox does not mean immediate deletion from every provider backup. The operator does not control GitHub’s security-log retention. See the linked GitHub and Atomic Mail privacy policies.

7. Your rights

Where the relevant law applies, you may request access, correction, deletion or restriction, and data portability where its conditions are met. You may withdraw consent for any future consent-based processing without affecting prior lawful processing.

Right to object: You may object to processing based on legitimate interests for reasons relating to your situation. We must consider the objection under the applicable rules; some records may lawfully need to be retained.

Send requests to the operator’s contact email. Provide only the information reasonably needed to identify the records and verify the request. EU and UK GDPR requests are normally answered within one month; a lawful extension of up to two further months will be explained within the initial period. Requests are generally free, subject to applicable exceptions. For data controlled independently by GitHub, use its privacy contact channels.

You may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), another competent EEA supervisory authority, or the UK Information Commissioner’s Office where applicable, without first contacting us.

8. Children

The drawings are designed for children, while downloads and printing can be managed by parents and teachers. We do not ask children to register, submit artwork, send photos or provide personal information. Technical information needed to deliver and secure the site is still handled by the host. The operator does not use it to build children’s profiles or for behavioral advertising.

Do not send a child’s personal details, image, voice, location or school information by email. If the operator learns that unnecessary information about a child has been received, they will remove it, except where a specific legal obligation requires retention. Parents or guardians may contact the operator about information concerning their child.

Parents and guardians may use the contact email to ask about or request deletion of personal information concerning their child. Please provide only enough information to locate the relevant message; do not send identity documents or additional details about the child unless specifically necessary.

9. International visitors

The website is available in English to visitors in different countries. The operator does not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising. You may contact the operator about access, correction or deletion of your information. Rights under local laws apply where their legal conditions are met. Exercising a privacy right will not affect access to the free drawings.

10. Security and updates

HTTPS and the hosting platform’s security measures protect delivery. No website or email system can guarantee absolute security. Please avoid sending confidential or sensitive information. If data uses or providers change, the notice will be updated before the new processing begins, with additional notice or consent where required.
